name: 小黑猫
evolution: 小黑猫 → 黑猫巫师 Lv.40 → 黑猫密探
description: 在白天，小黑猫们经常闭上眼睛，揣着手休息，如果冒昧地扒开它们的眼皮，会发现很多时候并没有在睡觉，有一种说法：小黑猫闭眼就是在思考。
descriptionEn: During the day, Xiaoheimao often close their eyes and rest with their paws tucked in. If you rudely pry open their eyelids, you'll find they are often not actually asleep. One theory holds that Xiaoheimao are deep in thought whenever they close their eyes.
